purpose: Define the authoritative precedence for physical plant size in CRUVIT Garden Design and plant-visual QA at catalog scale.
corePrinciple: Visual form describes architecture; it does not define absolute plant size.

authorityPrecedence.rule: Resolve the plant at the most specific supported taxonomic scope before assigning size.
Where cultivar, rootstock, training or maintained form materially changes size, context must be represented explicitly. Do not collapse these into a universal species size.
Use source-supported height and spread ranges for the resolved taxon/context when available.
Young, intermediate and mature states refine size. A mature range must not silently be applied to a young state.
Tree, shrub, herbaceous-clump, rosette, palm, climber and other forms constrain shape and presentation, not absolute size.
Photo calibration, placement depth, perspective and scene dimensions determine how botanical dimensions map into pixels.

A user-approved saved placement may calibrate the same canonical plant/form/architecture/growth stage and compatible sibling phenology states. It must never be copied across different plants merely because their morphology matches.
A user may resize a placement. This is design state, not botanical truth, and must not mutate canonical size evidence.
Form/stage bands such as Small/Medium/Large are fallback-only when stronger evidence is unavailable. They must be marked estimated and must never become species truth.

readinessStates.SIZE_AUTHORITY_READY: Source-supported dimensions are sufficient for direct size authority for the relevant state/context.
readinessStates.SIZE_AUTHORITY_PARTIAL: Some dimensions are source-supported and the rest are estimated explicitly.
readinessStates.SIZE_AUTHORITY_CONTEXT_REQUIRED: Cultivar/rootstock/maintained context materially affects final size.
readinessStates.SIZE_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT_HOLD: Evidence conflicts; do not average or silently select a source.
readinessStates.SIZE_AUTHORITY_ESTIMATED: Garden Design may show an explicitly estimated preview with manual resize; this is not meter-accurate truth.
readinessStates.SIZE_AUTHORITY_NOT_EVALUATED: Size authority has not yet been evaluated for this plant/state.

invariants: Same visualForm never implies same absolute size.
Mango dimensions must never be copied to Lemon, Lychee, Cypress, Oak or any other canonical plant.
Phenology alone does not change scale.
Height and spread are separate dimensions and both matter.
Independent X/Y stretching to fake botanical spread is forbidden.
Unknown is allowed; silent guessing is forbidden.
Saved placement scale is design calibration, not botanical catalog truth.
A sibling-state scale inheritance requires same canonical plant, same visual form, same architecture, same growth stage and compatible visible asset aspect.
Garden Design may remain usable with estimated size when authority is incomplete, but the estimate must be explicit.

nonTreeExpansion.rule: The same plant-specific height/spread authority model must expand to non-tree forms as catalog batches are added. Do not replace missing non-tree evidence with one universal form size.

batchRequirement.placementInPipeline: after BOTANICAL_DATA and before VISUAL_DEMAND / Garden Design readiness
